# Summarise Long Research PDFs with Cohere’s Clever API

**Hook:** Imagine turning a dense, fifty-page research paper into a crisp, one-page summary in under ten seconds. Whether you are a student tackling academic journals or a professional keeping up with industry reports, this guide will show you how to use Cohere to extract key insights without the headache.

## Before you start
- **A Cohere account:** You can sign up for a free developer account on Cohere’s website.
- **A research PDF:** Have a PDF document ready on your computer (for example, a study or an article).
- **Your text tool:** Ensure you can open and copy text from your PDF.

## Step 1 — Sign up and find your API Key
Before we can ask the AI to read our document, we need a digital passkey to access its brain. This passkey is called an **API Key** (Application Programming Interface Key — a unique password that securely connects your computer or web browser directly to the AI engine).

1. Log into your new Cohere dashboard.
2. Look at the left-hand menu and find a tab labelled **API Keys**.
3. Copy the active "Trial" API key. Keep this key private, just like you would with a bank password.

💬 *Example:* Your key will look like a long string of random letters and numbers, such as `a1B2c3D4e5...`

## Step 2 — Open the Cohere Playground
Writing code can be intimidating if you are just starting out. Thankfully, Cohere provides a **Playground** (an online sandbox or testing space where you can experiment with AI settings using simple buttons instead of writing code).

1. In your Cohere dashboard, look for the **Playground** button at the top or in the sidebar.
2. Select the **Summarise** option from the playground templates. 
3. You will now see a large text box on the left and a few setting sliders on the right.

## Step 3 — Extract and paste your PDF text
Currently, most APIs work best when you feed them raw text directly. We need to copy the text out of our PDF and give it to the tool.

1. Open your research PDF on your computer.
2. Highlight the main sections of the paper (the introduction, findings, and conclusion are usually the most important) and copy them.
3. Go back to your Cohere Playground window and paste the text into the big text box.

💬 *Example:* Paste the text right under the prompt area. Do not worry if the formatting looks a bit messy after pasting; the AI is smart enough to read past odd spacing and line breaks.

## Step 4 — Customise your summary settings
On the right side of the screen, you will see a panel of options. These sliders let you tell the AI exactly how you want your information presented.

1. **Length:** Choose between *Short*, *Medium*, or *Long*. For a quick overview, "Short" is best.
2. **Format:** Choose *Bullets* (perfect for quick scanning) or *Paragraph* (better for a narrative style).
3. **Extractiveness:** This slider controls how close the summary stays to the original wording. Set it to *Low* if you want a plain-English translation, or *High* if you need the exact academic terms preserved.

## Step 5 — Generate your summary
Now it is time to let the AI do the heavy lifting.

1. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click the **Generate** button.
2. Within a few seconds, a polished, easy-to-read summary will appear in the output window.
3. Copy this summary and save it in your study notes or work files for easy reference later.

💬 *Example output:* 
> **Key Findings:** 
> - The study tested 500 participants over twelve months.
> - Using AI tools reduced administrative tasks by 40%.
> - Participants reported higher satisfaction when using clear, visual interfaces.

## Common mistakes
- **Pasting scanned images:** If your PDF is a scanned photocopy of an old book, you will not be able to highlight and copy the text. Ensure you use "selectable" PDFs, or run the file through a document reader first to convert the images into real text.
- **Leaving the API key visible:** Never share screenshots that show your API key, and never paste it into public forums. If you accidentally share it, simply click "Regenerate Key" in your Cohere dashboard to disable the old one.

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life:** You can use this method to quickly understand long product manuals, rental agreements, or council planning reports before making big decisions.
- **For your business or work:** You can easily digest competitor research, market studies, or complex industry regulations without spending hours reading every page.
- **If you're just getting started:** Try starting with a short news article. Copying and pasting a page of text into the playground is the gentlest way to see how the AI structures its thoughts.

## Try it now
Open a browser tab, sign up for a free Cohere account, and copy just three paragraphs from any news article online. Paste it into the Cohere Summarise Playground, hit **Generate**, and watch how quickly it extracts the main point for you!
